verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly state you can use tools from any MCP server (as well as LangChain tools or Hub Spaces), confirming smolagents can plug in MCP servers as a tool source. However, there's no detailed documentation on setup/config specifics or independent hands-on corroboration of MCP integration specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated MCP integration docs/tutorial, independent third-party verification of MCP server usage.
